item.title: How to backup Airbyte on Google Cloud Storage?
item.description: I found on the airbyte forum how to backup the Airbyte instance to a new instance but I also used this resource to create a backup script of Airbyte. For a migration from one place to another Backup creation of the old instance Stop all the services docker-compose down Start only the database docker-compose up -d db Create the backup database file docker exec airbyte-db pg_dump -U docker airbyte > airbyte_backup.sql Stop the service again docker-compose down When you’ve done that you have generated airbyte_backup.sql file.
